name: Wand over Fist
summary: Skuerto at Refuge Pointe has worked out where the first of Trelane's items ended up. Kor'gresh has Trelane's Wand of Invocation in Boulderfist Hall, and Skuerto wants it brought back.

sections.title: The Ogre and the Wand
sections.body: After your work for Apprentice Kryten, Skuerto has found where Trelane's first item went. Kor'gresh holds it in Boulderfist Hall, and has been throwing blasts of ice at his own kin to keep them in line. Skuerto reckons the ogre must be close to figuring out all of the wand's powers. Boulderfist Hall lies south of Refuge Pointe and then east of Thandol Span.

sections.title: Skuerto's List
sections.body: On your return, Skuerto counts the wand as one item down and three more to go, according to his list. The other three are all in Stromgarde.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Wand over Fist?
aliases: where to get wand over fist
faq.answer: Skuerto, at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
Kor'gresh is in Boulderfist Hall, which lies south of Refuge Pointe and then east of Thandol Span.

faq.q: What item needs to be recovered?
faq.answer: Trelane's Wand of Invocation, the first of Trelane's items. Kor'gresh has been throwing blasts of ice at his kin with it.

faq.q: What prerequisites are needed for this quest?
aliases: previous quest to wand over fist
faq.answer: It follows Worth Its Weight in Gold, the work you did for Apprentice Kryten.
